description: This file implements the Reviews screen for a Flutter mobile app, allowing users to view, add, and interact with reviews for a restaurant or food item.

classes.name: _Review
classes.description: A data class representing individual user reviews with name, star rating, comment, date, and optional featured flag.

classes.name: _ReviewTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays individual review details in a card format.

methods.name: _ReviewsScreenState
methods.description: State class managing the review list, star rating selection, submitting reviews, and building the UI for ReviewsScreen.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ReviewsScreen, including the app bar, star rating, feedback input, submit button, and list of reviews.

methods.name: _ReviewTile.build
methods.description: Builds the visual representation of an individual review card.
